name: pb_unique_pairs_violations
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT parcel_id, building_id FROM parcel_buildings GROUP BY parcel_id, building_id HAVING count(*) > 1) d

name: pb_multi_primary_parcels
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT parcel_id FROM parcel_buildings WHERE is_primary GROUP BY parcel_id HAVING count(*) > 1) d

name: parcels_with_centroid
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcels WHERE centroid_lat IS NOT NULL AND centroid_lng IS NOT NULL

name: link_rate_pct
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT parcel_id) FROM parcel_buildings) / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM parcels WHERE centroid_lat IS NOT NULL AND centroid_lng IS NOT NULL), 0), 2)

name: confidence_values
sql: SELECT string_agg(c::text, ',' ORDER BY c) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT confidence AS c FROM parcel_buildings) s

name: nearest_share_pct
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE match_type = 'nearest') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) FROM parcel_buildings
